subject: sepulcra
title: A saved Sepulcra run loaded in a fresh engine
note: Save games: a seed-7 run with physics crates and a module, saved at tick 600 in one engine and loaded in another (save_check.py, headless). The slab, stones, walls and tombstones are adopted from the save's world and the enemies rebuilt from the game's state; desync_compare then matches the saving run on all 900 later ticks.
